item.title: Snowmobiler killed in Wasatch County avalanche
item.description: An avalanche killed one person on Wednesday in Wasatch County.

item.title: New Trump administration order could lead to the detention of thousands of legal refugees
item.description: The Trump administration has issued a new order that could lead to the arrest of tens of thousands of refugees who are lawfully in the United States but do not yet have permanent residency.

item.title: NASA conducts second rocket fueling test that will decide when Artemis astronauts head to the moon
item.description: NASA is taking another crack at fueling its giant moon rocket after leaks halted the initial dress rehearsal and delayed astronauts' first trip to the moon in more than half a century.

item.title: USU given its full funding back at last
item.description: The Utah Legislature’s Executive Appropriations Committee voted on Wednesday night to give Utah State University its full funding back after an audit looked at USU's spending decisions.

item.title: Storm puts dent in snowpack deficit, but it’s likely too late to catch up
item.description: This week's winter storm delivered an impressive amount of snow to Utah's mountains, but it still wasn't even close to enough to make up for what's been a near record low winter.

item.title: Young girl dies after getting caught in avalanche at Brighton Ski Resort
item.description: A young girl has died after she was caught in an avalanche near Brighton Ski Resort Thursday afternoon.

item.title: US trade deficit declined in 2025, but gap for goods hits a record despite Trump tariffs
item.description: The U.S. trade deficit slipped modestly in 2025, a year in which President Donald Trump upended global commerce by slapping double digit tariffs on imports from most countries.

item.title: Man identified after hospital asked for public’s help identifying him
item.description: Hospital employees were asking for the public's help identifying a man they said was brought in with no documentation or evidence of his identity. A family member has since contacted the hospital and positively identified him.

item.title: Provo Community Congregational United Church of Christ celebrates 135 years
item.description: The Provo Community Congregational United Church of Christ is celebrating 135 years of faith, service and community impact.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ and ‘Euphoria’ star, has died at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.
